name: Minimum down payment, mortgage default insurance threshold, insured price cap and amortization
description: Federal rules for buying with a mortgage: minimum down payment by price band; default insurance required below 20% down; insured mortgages available up to a $1.5 million purchase price; 30-year amortization for insured first-time buyers and new builds.

minimum_down_payment.rule: 5% of the first $500,000 + 10% of the portion above $500,000

attributes.first_time_buyer_definition_for_30y: Never purchased a home, or has not owned and occupied a principal residence in the last four years (Department of Finance backgrounder).
